::: {.lx-landing}

::: {.lx-intro}
Electricity is the one product that has to be made at the very moment it is used. These lessons explain how that works, what it costs and how people plan for it, with one small fictional town, Prairie Town, as the running example. Each lesson starts from a situation, asks you to guess, lets you try it in an interactive model, and then explains what happened in plain language. You can stop after any tier with a complete picture, or keep going until you can build, solve and question an optimization model of your own.
:::

::: {#learn-map}
:::

::: {.lx-landing-note}
Prairie Town is fictional, and its numbers are illustrative; every real-world number in the lessons carries a source and a date. Your guesses, answers and progress stay in your browser and are never sent anywhere. Written by Honglin Li.
:::
